why: Consumer Issues pin an exact 3.0.0-next.<N> and stop if npm does not serve it. v3-freeze-g1 only records N and never releases, so without this owner cut every linewatch and gallery Issue hits the stop branch. One cut per gate exit, with a stated reason.
what: Owner row, no code. The owner runs make release from master once v3-freeze-g1 has merged. If the row is filed, a lead only verifies the acceptance lines read-only and reports; it must not run make release or dispatch any workflow.
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 4.4 and 5 (G1 row); AGENTS.md Release Process (make release is the only front door). N is floors.G1.next in scripts/fleet.json, computed by v3-freeze-g1 with make release-dry. No release may land between that dry run and the freeze merge, so N is still the next number.
change: Owner: at the freeze-g1 merge commit run make release-dry and confirm it prints 3.0.0-next.<floors.G1.next>; then run make release, stated reason: 'G1 gate exit: linewatch and gallery pin this exact version'. A green exit means the registry serves it. If the dry run prints a different N, stop: a release landed after the freeze, and a one-line follow-up PR must correct floors.G1.next before the cut. A lead filing this row raises a factory Decision with these steps and keeps the Issue open until the acceptance lines hold; owns names only the changelog semantic-release writes.
commits: None. semantic-release writes its own release commit.
proof: Registry and tag reads below; the publish run log shows provenance.
acceptance: npm view basalt-ui@3.0.0-next.<N> version prints 3.0.0-next.<N>, with N from jq -r .floors.G1.next scripts/fleet.json
npm view basalt-ui dist-tags.next prints 3.0.0-next.<N> and dist-tags.latest does not print a 3.x version
git ls-remote --tags origin v3.0.0-next.<N> returns a ref and gh release view v3.0.0-next.<N> exits 0
out_of_scope: Any file change, the consumer pins, a second cut for the next gate (its own owner row), GA.
